source.content: @isTest private class DataDatabaseDeleteUndeleteIdSystemModeRuntimeTest { @isTest static void idOverloadsRunInSystemMode() { Account a1 = new Account(Name = 'Delete Id Access'); insert a1; System.assert(Database.delete(a1.Id, AccessLevel.SYSTEM_MODE).isSuccess()); System.assert(Database.undelete(a1.Id, AccessLevel.SYSTEM_MODE).isSuccess()); Account a2 = new Account(Name = 'Delete Id Both'); insert a2; System.assert(Database.delete(a2.Id, false, AccessLevel.SYSTEM_MODE).isSuccess()); System.assert(Database.undelete(a2.Id, false, AccessLevel.SYSTEM_MODE).isSuccess()); Account a3 = new Account(Name = 'Delete List Access'); Account a4 = new Account(Name = 'Delete List Access'); insert new List<Account>{a3, a4}; List<Id> ids1 = new List<Id>{a3.Id, a4.Id}; System.assertEquals(2, Database.delete(ids1, AccessLevel.SYSTEM_MODE).size()); System.assertEquals(2, Database.undelete(ids1, AccessLevel.SYSTEM_MODE).size()); Account a5 = new Account(Name = 'Delete List Both'); Account a6 = new Account(Name = 'Delete List Both'); insert new List<Account>{a5, a6}; List<Id> ids2 = new List<Id>{a5.Id, a6.Id}; System.assertEquals(2, Database.delete(ids2, false, AccessLevel.SYSTEM_MODE).size()); System.assertEquals(2, Database.undelete(ids2, false, AccessLevel.SYSTEM_MODE).size()); } }
